 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Golden State Warriors are on the road Monday night as they travel to take on the Denver Nuggets in a Western Conference matchup.
 Golden State enters Monday's game with an 0-3 record after losing on the road to the Phoenix Suns Saturday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Golden State Warriors forward Yaxel Lendeborg (1)Ed Szczepanski-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect
 In Saturday's loss, Yaxel Lendeborg led the way for the Warriors as he recorded 26 points, nine rebounds and five assists while De'Anthony Melton added 25 points, five rebounds, five assists and three steals of his own off the bench.
 The Warriors will try to bounce back Monday as they face off against the Nuggets in a tough road matchup.
 Denver enters Monday's contest with a 1-1 record after defeating the New Orleans Pelicans at home in overtime Saturday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Denver Nuggets center Nikola JokicJesse Johnson-Imagn Images
 Nikola Jokic led the way for the Nuggets in Saturday's victory as he ended the game with a triple-double as he recorded 35 points, 15 rebounds, 10 assists and three blocks while Jamal Murray put up 42 points, three rebounds and six assists.
 While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Monday night's matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Warriors Injury Report: Will Stephen Curry, Draymond Green Play?
 Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry (30) and forward Draymond Green (23).Kelley L Cox-Imagn Images
 The Warriors have six players listed on their injury report, though Stephen Curry and Draymond Green are not among them.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Of course, both Curry and Green missed Saturday's game as the Warriors elected to sit them in the second game of their back-to-back. They are off the injury report and will return against the Nuggets, along with Al Horford and Brandin Podziemski.
 Golden State has listed Gui Santos as questionable due to left knee tendinitis while Charles Bassey (right patellar tendinopathy) and Brandon Williams (lower-back soreness) have both been listed as probable and are expected to play.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Kristaps Porzingis has been ruled out as he remains away from the team while Jimmy Butler and Moses Moody both remain sidelined while recovering from knee surgeries.
 Nuggets Injury Report: Will Cameron Johnson, Spencer Jones Play?
 Denver Nuggets forward Cameron Johnson (23)Christopher Hanewinckel-Imagn Images
 The Nuggets have four players listed on their injury report, including Cameron Johnson and Spencer Jones.
 Denver has listed Johnson as doubtful due to a right ankle sprain and he is expected to miss his second consecutive contest.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Nuggets have also listed Alpha Diallo as doubtful and he is expected to be sidelined due to personal reasons and a right wrist sprain.
 Spencer Jones has been ruled out due to bilateral hamstring injury management while Julian Strawther remains sidelined with a left knee sprain.
 Denver Nuggets forward Spencer Jones (21)Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images
 Fans can catch Monday night's matchup between the Warriors and Nuggets from Ball Arena at 10 p.m. ET on Peacock and NBCSN.
